libraries.title: Central Keys Library
libraries.summary: Two grand pianos (Steinway B and Kawai), an upright, FM pianos, a clavisynth and a harpsichord; pipe, quiet and positive organs; vibraphone, marimba, xylophone, glockenspiel, bells and hand chimes; twelve stereo pads, each with its own character (warm, air, choir aah and ooh, shimmer, strings, glass, swell, worship, analog sweep, dark and bell) - with worship-ready presets; and ten synths made by us, each its own kind (saw, square and soft leads, synth brass, super saw, string machine, sub and synth bass, a plucked string, FM electric bells).

libraries.title: Central Instrument Library
libraries.summary: Four drum kits (studio, rock, unruly, brushes); hollowbody, archtop and clean electric guitars; upright (plucked and bowed), jazz and hollowbody basses; alto and baritone saxes and a sax section; harps, kalimbas, recorders, harmonicas, saxello, ocarina, world instruments and percussion kits - with presets to play from keys or your instrument; an electric upright bass (plucked and bowed); and twenty drum and percussion loops for the texture channels, each with its own feel and tempos - worship eighths, a big ride, rim and hat, half-time, four on the floor, driving sixteenths, toms, brushes (ballad, waltz and swing), a waltz, a gospel shuffle, a 6/8 ballad, 6/8 Celtic toms, a train beat, kick and clap, a cajon groove, shaker and congas, a frame drum in 6/8 and a cinematic swell.

libraries.title: Central Pads Library
libraries.summary: 20 pads for the pad pedal in all 12 keys - warm, air, choir aah, choir ooh, choir hum, shimmer, strings, bowed, glass, bells, felt, organ, analog, swell, worship, ambient drone, cinematic, deep, heaven and morning. Each is built its own way (its own voices, movement, stereo and reverb) and is a seamless 12-second stereo loop of the key's chord, played as recorded (no pitch shifting). Comes with every other plan too. Plus eight ambient loops for the texture channels in every key, each its own colour - Sparkle (bells), Drift (two pads trading places), Breath (air), Felt Piano, Guitar Swells, Cello Drone, Choir Air and Harp Rain.
credits: Ambient loops made by Motion Audio (tools/make-loops.py) from our synthesised pads and bells and the libraries' own instruments (piano, harp: VCSL; guitar and bowed bass: Karoryfer; cello: VSCO 2 CE - all CC0 1.0)

libraries.title: Central Utility Library
libraries.summary: Fourteen metronome click sets (wood block, rim, hi-hat, cowbell, clave, shaker, side stick, triangle, mechanical tick, beeps, square blip, low tom, finger snap), each with its own accent, for a song's Click sound; and 24 lighting looks for the lights page (sunrise, ocean, candlelight, backlit cross, royal purple, gospel celebration, hymn rock, communion, baptism, Christmas, Easter, sermon, kids, youth and more). Slide templates, lyric backgrounds and graphics come next. All made by Motion Audio.
